correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction from incidence matrix units: idempotents force offdiagonal row/column support without division by two; polarization of orthogonal idempotents produces a unique strict inner correction; two Peirce equations force a scalar on each strict interval; chain polarization imposes transitive cocycle equations; transitivity yields Leibniz on every basis product. The R-module parametrization is injective/surjective. Universal coefficients determine the exact finite-ring cardinality, and an integral Smith presentation verifies the RP2 witness. Independent finite-system checker compares all R-linear square and Leibniz solution spaces across 21 field and 5 Z/4 configurations. Checks corroborate rather than replace the general proof.

value.rationale: Square-only Jordan derivations over arbitrary 2-torsion rings are a natural open boundary of Xiao’s foundational incidence result, because imposing the triple-product identity changes the problem. The proof resolves the finite-poset case uniformly over all commutative rings. The cohomology formula yields a complete exact derivation census sensitive to integral H1 torsion; on the RP2 face poset it distinguishes F4 from Z/4 despite equal cardinalities. This is a structural and reusable invariant, not an isolated low-dimensional count.
